name: chronos
description: Detect Codex degradation, approval loops, quota amplification, workflow regressions, SQLite churn, and coordinate bounded read workers on Windows.

interface.longDescription: Check Windows process, memory, disk, diagnostic-log, token-quota, approval persistence, permission-rule, reviewer-escalation, lineage, fork-context, and rollout health; detect actionable transitions during long-running work; discover active tasks through privacy-bounded lifecycle hints; and coordinate bounded Codex read tasks using runtime model discovery, canonical workspace identity, advisory leases, privacy limits, and coordinator verification.
defaultPrompt: Use Chronos to check installation sources and current Codex resource health.
Use Chronos to explain current token and approval pressure.
Enable Chronos supervision in one dedicated Governor task.
